  PROBLEM: In run_managed_failure_fingerprint_breaker, `_failure_fingerprint_breaker_apply "${ffb_issue}" "managed" || continue` handles rc=2 (comment POST failed, rollback unverified, label likely still applied) the same way as rc=1, so the LABELS_JSON patch at 22719-22720 is skipped and LABELS_JSON never gets `ai:needs-human`.
  WHY: check-stalls runs later in the same tick with `--labels-json "${LABELS_JSON}"` (30797-30804) and skips an issue only when `"ai:needs-human" in labels` (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:2564-2566). So execute_stall_recovery_action can post `/answer` or `/approved`, or retrigger a phase, on an issue that is already human-gated. The standalone caller (23142-23146) handles this case correctly. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; there is no severity disagreement.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22616-22620, 22644-22651 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: get_issue_labels_json (4380-4383: `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq ... || echo '[]'`) turns a failed label read into `[]`. has_label then treats the label as removed, so _failure_fingerprint_breaker_apply logs `rollback=done` and returns 1. Its own contract says "Return 2 when the rollback cannot be verified". openai_gpt-6-luna reports the same problem for the label-add verification read at 22616-22620.
  WHY: The standalone caller (23131-23146) treats rc=1 as permission to fall through to the legacy stall ladder in the same tick. auto_respond_clarify or retrigger_plan can then post `/answer`, `/reclarify` or `/approved` while `ai:plan-failed`, `ai:clarify-failed` or `ai:needs-human` is still applied. The trigger needs two API faults in a row. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; there is no severity disagreement.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22718 (run_managed_failure_fingerprint_breaker, trip arm; LABELS_JSON patch 22719-22720; check-stalls 30797-30803) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The managed caller's `|| continue` treats rc=2 the same as rc=1, so LABELS_JSON never gets `ai:needs-human`. The standalone caller handles rc=2 correctly at 23142-23146.
  WHY: check-stalls skips only when `"ai:needs-human" in labels` (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:2564-2566), so recovery can post `/answer` or `/approved`, or retrigger a phase, on a human-gated issue. Fix: capture ffb_rc, patch LABELS_JSON on 0 or 2, and continue when the code is not 0.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22644-22651 (_failure_fingerprint_breaker_apply rollback; get_issue_labels_json 4380-4383) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed verification read becomes `[]`, so the function logs `rollback=done` and returns 1 when it should return 2.
  WHY: The standalone caller (23131-23146) falls through to the recovery ladder while the failure label is still applied. Fix: require `jq -e 'type == "array"'`, otherwise log `rollback=unverified` and return 2. The trigger is uncommon because it needs two API faults in a row.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: the same two fixes (about 5 and 4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3. Task gaps: NONE (marker emitters belong to sibling phase P3a).
